\begin{cases}
1 & \text{if } n \text{ is a triangular number}, \\
a(n-1) \cdot \frac{n}{n - m} & \text{otherwise},
\end{cases}
$$

where $ m $ is the largest triangular number less than $ n $.

This recurrence captures the behavior of the sequence, resetting to 1 at each triangular number and growing in a structured way in between.
